about_the_game: This is the OST for the MMORPG Embers Adrift composed by James Stratton-Crawley. Experience this beautiful music in our unique fantasy world filled with fantastical creatures, dangers and dungeons, and a unique magic system called alchemy that is available to every class. Buy our soundtrack to support our small indie team!
